posts.text: Diesel prices in America reached a record high right before Labor Day. At $5.85 a gallon on average, this is the highest price Americans have ever paid for a diesel, making most things that are delivered in the United States, including food more expensive for the American families.  The high prices are the results of Trump enacted policies, including the prolonged war against Iran.
